Load libraries
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```


Load data
```{r}
seurat_obj <- readRDS(file = "seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_subset_300_filtered.rds")

seurat_obj
head(seurat_obj)
table(seurat_obj$cell_anno)
```




```{r}
metadata <- read_csv2(file = "DEG_output/Fishers_exact_test_MDD_top.csv")
```


Add p-values to the seurat objects metadata.
```{r}

# Convert character columns to numeric first (important)
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = as.numeric(p_value),
    adj_p_value = as.numeric(adj_p_value)
  )

# Extract the current metadata
seurat_meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data

# Add only the new columns by joining on cell type
new_cols <- seurat_meta %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>% dplyr::select(cluster, p_value, adj_p_value),
    by = c("cell_anno" = "cluster")
  )

# Update the Seurat object's metadata
seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(
  seurat_obj,
  metadata = new_cols
)


head(seurat_obj[[]])
```


Add two new columns with -log10 transformed values
```{r}
# Create a new dataframe with the transformed columns
new_cols <- data.frame(
  neglog_pval = -log10(seurat_obj$p_value),
  neglog_adj_pval = -log10(seurat_obj$adj_p_value),
  row.names = rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
)

# Add to Seurat metadata
seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, metadata = new_cols)

head(seurat_obj[[]])
```



```{r}
cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC"  = "#FC8D62",
  "INP"  = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"   = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN"  = "#A6D854",
  "GN"   = "#66C2A5",
  "In"   = "#00A9FF",
  "EXN"  = "#F8766D",
  "Endo" = "#CD9600",
  "Epend"= "#C77CFF",
  "OPC"  = "#00BE67",
  "Oligo"= "#7CAE00",
  "Astro"= "#00BFC4",
  "Immune" = "#FF61CC"
)

# Reorder the identities to match the order in cell_colors
#seurat_obj$cell_anno <- factor(seurat_obj$cell_anno, levels = names(cell_colors))


Idents(seurat_obj) <- seurat_obj$cell_anno

VlnPlot(
  seurat_obj,
  features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"),
  pt.size = 0.1,    # size of points
  ncol = 2,         # plot side by side
  cols = cell_colors
)

```



```{r}
# 1. Normalize data
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)

# 2. Find variable features
seurat_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj)

# 3. Scale data
seurat_obj <- ScaleData(seurat_obj)

# 4. Run PCA
seurat_obj <- RunPCA(seurat_obj)

# 5. Elbow plot to help choose number of PCs
ElbowPlot(seurat_obj, ndims = 50)  # plots variance explained by top 50 PCs

```


```{r}
# Run t-SNE using the first 20 PCs
set.seed(123)
seurat_obj <- RunTSNE(seurat_obj, dims = 1:30)

# Plot t-SNE colored by cell_anno
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "cell_anno", label = TRUE, cols = cell_colors)
```


Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("plots/tSNE_cell_anno.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

# Plot your Seurat plot
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "cell_anno", label = TRUE, cols = cell_colors)

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```


```{r}
# Plot t-SNE colored by orig.ident
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, features = "neglog_adj_pval", reduction = "tsne") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),  # x and y axis titles
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")                  # x and y axis tick labels
  )


```

```{r}
library(harmony)

# Run Harmony
seurat_obj <- RunHarmony(
  seurat_obj,             # Seurat object
  group.by.vars = "orig.ident",  # batch variable to regress out
  dims.use = 1:50             # PCA dimensions to harmonize
)

ElbowPlot(seurat_obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "harmony")
```


```{r}
# Run t-SNE using the first 20 PCs
set.seed(123)
seurat_obj <- RunTSNE(seurat_obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")

# Plot t-SNE colored by cell_anno
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "cell_anno", label = TRUE, cols = cell_colors)
```
